{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_count}')

# Show how many times each patient appears
print('\nTop 5 patients with multiple entries:')
print(duplicate_patients.head())"}
